statement: About noon on 3 July, during the enemy's attack on the left center, fugitives rushed to the rear along the road on which Ewing stood with the ammunition train; he deployed the 4th New Jersey across the road and into the woods on his right with fixed bayonets and reorganized 400 to 500 men, whom he turned over to General Patrick.
